dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「おっ｛ち／死｝んじゃえ〜〜〜！！」
dialogues.en: "Dieee!!"
dialogues.text: "Dieee!!"

dialogues.jp: 最後の記憶の最初の言葉は｛ばり／罵詈｝｛ぞうごん／雑言｝だった。
dialogues.en:
The first words of my last memory of her was rather
uncomplimentary.
dialogues.text:
The first words of my last memory of her was rather
uncomplimentary.

dialogues.jp:
――と言うか、幼なじみだった、さくらんぼの
記憶の始まりはいつもこんな感じだ。
dialogues.en:
--That is, whenever I think of my childhood friend
Sakuranbo, this is always the first memory that pops up.
dialogues.text:
--That is, whenever I think of my childhood friend
Sakuranbo, this is always the first memory that pops up.

dialogues.jp: ある春の日。
dialogues.en: On that day in Spring.
dialogues.text: On that day in Spring.

dialogues.jp: 風の強い――春一番が吹いた日。
dialogues.en:
The wind was strong-- the strongest of the entire Spring
season.
dialogues.text:
The wind was strong-- the strongest of the entire Spring
season.

dialogues.jp:
去年から枯れなくなった桜の下で、耳から手を
離してため息をつく。
dialogues.en:
Under the Sakura tree that did not wither the year before, I
remove my hands from my ears and release a sigh.
dialogues.text:
Under the Sakura tree that did not wither the year before, I
remove my hands from my ears and release a sigh.

dialogues.jp: 「……どうしてお前はいつもそうなんだ？」
dialogues.en: "...Why are you always trying to do that?"
dialogues.text: "...Why are you always trying to do that?"

dialogues.jp: 出会い頭にぶつからないと気が済まないのか、
dialogues.en:
It's like striking your head against a brick wall to break
it...
dialogues.text:
It's like striking your head against a brick wall to break
it...

dialogues.jp: 実はこれが挨拶なのかな……？
dialogues.en: Or is this her form of greeting the tree?
dialogues.text: Or is this her form of greeting the tree?

dialogues.jp:
今日の夕方には引っ越しして、いなくなってし
まう少女は、なんの理由もなく怒っていた。
dialogues.en:
The girl, after tonight, will be moving far away. Yet she
remained glaring at the tree, angry for no discernable
reason.
dialogues.text:
The girl, after tonight, will be moving far away. Yet she
remained glaring at the tree, angry for no discernable
reason.

dialogues.jp: 金属バットで肩を叩きながら俺は首をかしげる。
dialogues.en: I rest my head on the metal bat on my shoulder.
dialogues.text: I rest my head on the metal bat on my shoulder.

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「ところでお兄ちゃん。なんでバットなんて持っ
　てるの？」
dialogues.en: "By the way onii-chan, why are you carrying a bat around?"
dialogues.text: "By the way onii-chan, why are you carrying a bat around?"

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「……いいかげんお兄ちゃんって呼ぶなよ」
dialogues.en: "...Stop calling me onii-chan already."
dialogues.text: "...Stop calling me onii-chan already."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「なんで？　音夢ちゃんはお兄ちゃんって呼ん
　でるもん」
dialogues.en: "Why not? Nemu-chan always calls you that!"
dialogues.text: "Why not? Nemu-chan always calls you that!"

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「音夢は俺の妹になったんだ」
dialogues.en: "She's actually my sister."
dialogues.text: "She's actually my sister."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「ボクは最初から｛いとこ／従姉｝だもん！」
dialogues.en: "And I'm your first cousin!"
dialogues.text: "And I'm your first cousin!"

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「従姉で誕生日が先だから、お前の方がお姉ちゃ
　んになるんだって……」
dialogues.en:
"Since your birthday comes first, I should be calling you
onee-chan instead..."
dialogues.text:
"Since your birthday comes first, I should be calling you
onee-chan instead..."

dialogues.jp: これ以上、妹が増えたって面倒だ。
dialogues.en:
Looks like the number of little sisters I have is
increasing.
dialogues.text:
Looks like the number of little sisters I have is
increasing.

dialogues.jp:
世の中には１ダースも妹がいる奴もいるって話
だけど。
dialogues.en:
Even if I had one dozen little sisters, I bet she'd still
insist on being one.
dialogues.text:
Even if I had one dozen little sisters, I bet she'd still
insist on being one.

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「嫌だよお兄ちゃんのお姉さんなんて……ボク
　のことも守ってよ」
dialogues.en:
"I don't want you calling me onee-chan... you're always the
one protecting me after all."
dialogues.text:
"I don't want you calling me onee-chan... you're always the
one protecting me after all."

dialogues.jp:
従姉の少女が肩を落とす。小さすぎて、最後に
何を言ったのか聞こえなかった。
dialogues.en:
My cousin's shoulders dropped. Her muttered words after were
inaudible to me.
dialogues.text:
My cousin's shoulders dropped. Her muttered words after were
inaudible to me.

dialogues.jp:
「名前はいいよ、何回言っても直らないんだか
　ら」
dialogues.en:
"Well, whatever. No matter how many times I tell you to, you
won't stop anyway."
dialogues.text:
"Well, whatever. No matter how many times I tell you to, you
won't stop anyway."

dialogues.jp: 「で、バットはこれのせい」
dialogues.en: "And, I brought a bat because of this."
dialogues.text: "And, I brought a bat because of this."

dialogues.jp:
俺は時代がかった“果たし状”と書かれた、段々
折りの紙を開いた。
dialogues.en:
I showed her an envelope with "fight challenge" written on
it, then opened it and read it aloud.
dialogues.text:
I showed her an envelope with "fight challenge" written on
it, then opened it and read it aloud.

dialogues.jp:
「本日午後三時、枯れずの桜の下に来られたし。
　約束違うることあらば、家人の命は亡きもの
　と思え……」
dialogues.en:
"Be at the dead sakura tree at 3 PM today. If you don't
appear, you will see your family members dead...."
dialogues.text:
"Be at the dead sakura tree at 3 PM today. If you don't
appear, you will see your family members dead...."

dialogues.jp:
必死に国語辞典をひきながら、意味を理解する
のに１５分もかかった代物だ。
dialogues.en:
The definition of desperation, threatening innocents' lives.
Having understood the situation, I got there 15 minutes
early.
dialogues.text:
The definition of desperation, threatening innocents' lives.
Having understood the situation, I got there 15 minutes
early.

dialogues.jp:
「引っ越しをするから、ついに俺と決着をつけ
　ようと思ったんじゃないのか？」
dialogues.en:
"Since you're moving away, I suppose you wanted to have a
"final confrontation" of sorts?"
dialogues.text:
"Since you're moving away, I suppose you wanted to have a
"final confrontation" of sorts?"

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「どうしてそう思うのよ……」
dialogues.en: "Why do you think that..."
dialogues.text: "Why do you think that..."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「これを読んで、それ以外になにを思うんだ
　よ……」
dialogues.en: "From reading this, it's hard to think otherwise."
dialogues.text: "From reading this, it's hard to think otherwise."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「とっても大事なことは、そー書くと絶対大丈
　夫だって時代劇でやってたよ」
dialogues.en:
"Since it's such a huge thing, I copied that from a play I
read once."
dialogues.text:
"Since it's such a huge thing, I copied that from a play I
read once."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「その後の展開まで、ちゃんと見てるのか、お
　前……」
dialogues.en: "And just look at how you've made things..."
dialogues.text: "And just look at how you've made things..."

dialogues.jp:
おじいちゃん子だったコイツは、なんだか時代
劇とか｛・・・・・／ニンキョー｝とかの言葉をよく使う。
dialogues.en:
"How on earth did my uncle's daughter get such... words,
from a play...
dialogues.text:
"How on earth did my uncle's daughter get such... words,
from a play...

dialogues.jp: 「それで、どうしたって？」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, why?"
dialogues.text: "Anyway, why?"

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「……ボク引っ越しするんだ」
dialogues.en: "...You know I'm moving."
dialogues.text: "...You know I'm moving."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「｛・・・・／あめりか｝に行くんだよな」
dialogues.en: "...To America, right?"
dialogues.text: "...To America, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「うん。だから……もう２度と会えないかも知
　れないから、約束して欲しいんだ……」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah. That's why... I don't know when we'd be able to meet
again, so I want you to make a promise to me."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah. That's why... I don't know when we'd be able to meet
again, so I want you to make a promise to me."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「そんなことしなくても。寂しくなったら会い
　に行くから」
dialogues.en: "Not true. If you're lonely, I'd go and keep you company."
dialogues.text: "Not true. If you're lonely, I'd go and keep you company."

dialogues.jp: 俺はけっこう適当に頷いた。
dialogues.en: I vigourously nod my head.
dialogues.text: I vigourously nod my head.

dialogues.jp: その日は、音夢がいなくなってしまった日で――
dialogues.en: On that day, Nemu was nowhere to be found--
dialogues.text: On that day, Nemu was nowhere to be found--

dialogues.jp:
俺も、本当はここに来るつもりはなかったの
だ……。
dialogues.en: and my real reason to come here was lost.
dialogues.text: and my real reason to come here was lost.

dialogues.jp:
音夢が――妹がいなくなって……もしかしたら、
さくらんぼと仲の良かったアイツも呼ばれたの
かと思ったのだ。
dialogues.en:
If Nemu--my little sister did not exist... maybe I would be
more comfortable with her calling me that.
dialogues.text:
If Nemu--my little sister did not exist... maybe I would be
more comfortable with her calling me that.

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「ひとりで飛行機に乗って？」
dialogues.en: "You can board an aeroplane by yourself?"
dialogues.text: "You can board an aeroplane by yourself?"

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「え！？　｛・・・・／あめりか｝って電車でいけるところじゃ
　ないのか？」
dialogues.en: "Ehh!? Can't you reach America by train?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh!? Can't you reach America by train?"

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.en: "......Eh? No way?"
dialogues.text: "......Eh? No way?"

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「大バカ」
dialogues.en: "You big idiot."
dialogues.text: "You big idiot."

dialogues.jp:
目がウルウルとしていて、俺の心も急にドキド
キしだした。
dialogues.en:
Her eyes started to tear up, and my heart started beating
faster.
dialogues.text:
Her eyes started to tear up, and my heart started beating
faster.

dialogues.jp: コイツともう会えない？
dialogues.en: I can't meet her anymore?
dialogues.text: I can't meet her anymore?

dialogues.jp: いなくなってしまう。
dialogues.en: She won't be here anymore.
dialogues.text: She won't be here anymore.

dialogues.jp:
それは、音夢の両親が死んだことと、何の違い
があるんだろう――。
dialogues.en: It's not much different from when Nemu's parents died--
dialogues.text: It's not much different from when Nemu's parents died--

dialogues.jp:
痛いドキドキに、音夢のことをバカにしていた
自分が、凄く嫌な奴だと思った。
dialogues.en:
My heard throbbed painfully, and I berated myself for
remembering that subject again.
dialogues.text:
My heard throbbed painfully, and I berated myself for
remembering that subject again.

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「だから、ボクと約束して……この桜の下で」
dialogues.en:
"That's why I want you to make a promise with me, under this
sakura tree."
dialogues.text:
"That's why I want you to make a promise with me, under this
sakura tree."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「……もう１度会えるように？」
dialogues.en: "...That we'd meet again?"
dialogues.text: "...That we'd meet again?"

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.en: "...Yeah."
dialogues.text: "...Yeah."

dialogues.jp: 俺は目を閉じて呟いた。
dialogues.en: I closed my eyes and murmured quietly.
dialogues.text: I closed my eyes and murmured quietly.

dialogues.jp: 「約束する……」
dialogues.en: "I promise..."
dialogues.text: "I promise..."

dialogues.jp: 「絶対に、俺とお前はまた会える」
dialogues.en: "...That definitely, we'd meet again."
dialogues.text: "...That definitely, we'd meet again."

dialogues.jp: 「……絶対に会う」
dialogues.en: "...I promise."
dialogues.text: "...I promise."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.en: "...I promise."
dialogues.text: "...I promise."

dialogues.jp:
目を開けると、さくらんぼがしおらしく俯いて
いた。
dialogues.en: As I opened my eyes, Sakuranbo still had her head down.
dialogues.text: As I opened my eyes, Sakuranbo still had her head down.

dialogues.jp: 「手紙も書くし、電話もするよ」
dialogues.en: "I can still write letters and call you."
dialogues.text: "I can still write letters and call you."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「向こういったら少しは大人しくしろよ。また
　いじめられても、今度は助けられないからな」
dialogues.en:
"Grow up fast when you get there. If you get bullied again,
I can't save you this time."
dialogues.text:
"Grow up fast when you get there. If you get bullied again,
I can't save you this time."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「大人しくしたって無理だよー。背がちっちゃ
　いからいじめられるんだもん……」
dialogues.en:
"I can't grow up so fast~... besides, they don't usually
tease me about my height..."
dialogues.text:
"I can't grow up so fast~... besides, they don't usually
tease me about my height..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は言葉遣いと手癖の悪さだと思うけど……。
dialogues.en: She misunderstood what I said...
dialogues.text: She misunderstood what I said...

dialogues.jp:
まぁ、さくらんぼをいじめている男子は、本当
はコイツのことが好きなんだけどな……。
dialogues.en:
Well, if she gets teased by guys, that usually means they
like her anyway...
dialogues.text:
Well, if she gets teased by guys, that usually means they
like her anyway...

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「……あとふたつ約束してくれないかなぁ？」
dialogues.en: "...Can I get a second promise?"
dialogues.text: "...Can I get a second promise?"

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「ふたつも？」
dialogues.en: "Another one?"
dialogues.text: "Another one?"

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「ボクが本当に困ったときは、助けにきて……」
dialogues.en: "When I'm really in trouble, come save me..."
dialogues.text: "When I'm really in trouble, come save me..."

dialogues.jp: さくらが泣いているのをはじめて見た。
dialogues.en: Sakura finally started crying.
dialogues.text: Sakura finally started crying.

dialogues.jp:
いっつもいじめられていて、俺が守ってやって、
それでも強気に振る舞っていたのに。
dialogues.en:
Although she was always bullied, since I was protecting her,
she was able to hold on...
dialogues.text:
Although she was always bullied, since I was protecting her,
she was able to hold on...

dialogues.jp: 本当に、お別れなんだなって思った。
dialogues.en: I honestly don't know what'd happen when I'm not there.
dialogues.text: I honestly don't know what'd happen when I'm not there.

dialogues.jp: 「……それは約束しない」
dialogues.en: "...I won't promise that."
dialogues.text: "...I won't promise that."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「約束しなくても助ける。約束なんてしなくて
　いい」
dialogues.en: "I don't need a promise to save you. I'd do it without one."
dialogues.text: "I don't need a promise to save you. I'd do it without one."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「……うん。あっがとうお兄ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "...okay. T-thank you, onii-chan."
dialogues.text: "...okay. T-thank you, onii-chan."

dialogues.jp: 舌足らずに微笑む。
dialogues.en: Stuttering a bit, but at least smiling.
dialogues.text: Stuttering a bit, but at least smiling.

dialogues.jp:
俺は少女の手をとって、ぼとぼとと、ありった
けの和菓子を手の上に産み落とした。
dialogues.en:
I show her my hand, and after a bit of movement, make a
wagashi appear from it.
dialogues.text:
I show her my hand, and after a bit of movement, make a
wagashi appear from it.

dialogues.jp: 「お土産」
dialogues.en: "Here, a present."
dialogues.text: "Here, a present."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとう……やっぱり不思議だね」
dialogues.en: "Thank you... that's still weird though."
dialogues.text: "Thank you... that's still weird though."

dialogues.jp:
唯一、俺の力のことを知っているさくらんぼが
呟く。
dialogues.en:
Sakuranbo murmured, the only person on earth who knows about
my power.
dialogues.text:
Sakuranbo murmured, the only person on earth who knows about
my power.

dialogues.jp:
「もう大丈夫だろ？　そろそろ行かないと、お
　じさんとおばさんに置いてかれちゃうぞ」
dialogues.en:
"You okay now? If you don't go, grandpa and grandma're going
to leave you behind."
dialogues.text:
"You okay now? If you don't go, grandpa and grandma're going
to leave you behind."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.en: "--Wait!"
dialogues.text: "--Wait!"

dialogues.jp: 桜の花びらの中で、真剣な声が響いた。
dialogues.en: Her voice revberberated through the falling sakura petals.
dialogues.text: Her voice revberberated through the falling sakura petals.

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「あとひとつだけ約束して……」
dialogues.en: "Promise me one more thing..."
dialogues.text: "Promise me one more thing..."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「約束なんてしなくても大丈夫だよ」
dialogues.en: "Whatever it is, I'd do it."
dialogues.text: "Whatever it is, I'd do it."

dialogues.jp: それでも声は止まらなかった。
dialogues.en: For once, her voice fell silent.
dialogues.text: For once, her voice fell silent.

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「ボクとお兄ちゃんが、もう一度会えたら」
dialogues.en: "You and me, when we meet again..."
dialogues.text: "You and me, when we meet again..."

dialogues.jp: 風が吹いた。
dialogues.en: The wind belew past us.
dialogues.text: The wind belew past us.

dialogues.jp: 強い強い風が――。
dialogues.en: A wind getting stronger and stronger.
dialogues.text: A wind getting stronger and stronger.

dialogues.jp:
一度、その言葉は流れてしまい、さくらんぼが
深呼吸して唇を噛む。
dialogues.en:
As her last words disappeared into the wind, Sakuranbo took
a deep breath and chewed on her lower lip.
dialogues.text:
As her last words disappeared into the wind, Sakuranbo took
a deep breath and chewed on her lower lip.

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「その時は――」
dialogues.en: "When that happens--"
dialogues.text: "When that happens--"

dialogues.jp: リリン――
dialogues.en: --*ringring*
dialogues.text: --*ringring*

dialogues.jp: ジジ――
dialogues.en: --*shiishii*
dialogues.text: --*shiishii*

dialogues.jp:
鈴の音と、テレビのチャンネルを変えたような
音がして、視界が白く染まった。
dialogues.en:
At the sound of a bell, and another one of a television
changing channels, everything went white.
dialogues.text:
At the sound of a bell, and another one of a television
changing channels, everything went white.

dialogues.jp: ◆さくらとの約束◆
dialogues.en: ◆Sakura's Promise◆
dialogues.text: ◆Sakura's Promise◆

dialogues.jp: 幼なじみから、おっ｛ち／死｝ね、などと言われた日。
dialogues.en:
The day when we were still kids, with the words "Die!"
ringing in my ears.
dialogues.text:
The day when we were still kids, with the words "Die!"
ringing in my ears.

dialogues.jp:
アメリカは、電車なんかでは決して行けないく
らい遠いと知った。さくらが行くアメリカ……。
dialogues.en:
I found out that America could not be reached by train. The
same America that Sakura was going to...
dialogues.text:
I found out that America could not be reached by train. The
same America that Sakura was going to...

dialogues.jp:
そして、俺達は、いくつかの約束を交わした
……。
dialogues.en: So the two of us made promises...
dialogues.text: So the two of us made promises...
